comment: TERRAZA -> WIRE2, 2026-11-08. Everything as plate fractions of assets/art/terraza/terraza-room.png (832x1248, the clean plate from accepted 996100, floor graded to night by tool/art/rooms/terraza_plate.py). Camera: tool/art/rooms/terraza.json, unchanged from the guide, because pass 2 kept the guide's floor: the balustrade's foot is at y .455 and the painted tile lines meet the guide's lanes near x .5. Proposals; WIRE2 may move marks, but keep them on the floor.

floorCamera.note: Standing adult height at foot y = (y - 0.36) / 0.85, as a fraction of plate height. Mācron at heroHome is 45.6 logical px (garden 38.4, salon 45).

floor.note: The whole width below the balustrade's foot (y .455) is open terrace floor. The planters at the far corners stand on it at x < .2 and x > .8, y .41-.47; the near corner planters are outside a phone's crop.

challenger.note: meetMark is on Mācron's left, so in the close-up she is on the picture's left, as the art is drawn (style guide 8.1, rule 3). His heroStep for the win: (.56, .56).

exit.note: Mācron dances off to the right and up to the stair head between the two lantern posts (x .58-.73, foot y .455). Every point is on the floor and inside a 390x844 phone crop (x .153-.847). Guests are kept off x .58-.74 below y .60 so he is seen all the way.

guests.note: Twelve places. Reused atlases in summer evening wear [P]: guest3-6 (amber-gold dress, lavender shirt and bow tie, plum wrap dress, rust suit jacket) dance as couples with their pair_dance clips; guest0-2 (the lawn's blouse and palazzo trousers, linen waistcoat, guayabera and panama) dance alone. All are behind her mark (y < .557), thinning toward the viewer, and nobody stands in the exit route or the middle behind her (x .40-.58).
